skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the core concepts of consumer behavior and decision-making process.
Analyze external factors influencing consumer behavior and apply this knowledge to marketing decisions.
Analyze internal factors influencing consumer behavior and apply this knowledge to marketing decisions.
Apply knowledge to analyze factors affecting consumer behavior and propose marketing solutions.
Develop written and oral communication skills in Vietnamese.
Work effectively in teams, support team members, and demonstrate dynamic and flexible teamwork.
